concerns.text: The plan cites the Million Song Dataset (MSD) as the source of user‑track listen timestamps (see T001 – `https://huggingface.co/datasets/MSD-Team/LLMTest/resolve/main/LLMPersian_Train.jsonl`). MSD contains only track metadata and audio features; it does **not** include per‑user listening histories or timestamps required to compute the adolescent exposure ratio. Using MSD therefore cannot satisfy FR‑001 (adolescent_exposure_ratio) and makes the core research question unanswerable with the cited data.
